research_chain.objective: Improve reusable ARE reasoning and completed outcomes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
research_chain.gap: Unchanged H72 passed 10K development but required fresh confirmation.
research_chain.question: Does unchanged unconditional H72 transfer reliably at 10K?
research_chain.result: Round 56 passed; Round 58 was instrument-valid but failed the semantic confirmation gate.
research_chain.observation: Token savings replicated, but unconditional quality benefit diluted. A post-hoc handle-count split replicated across the development and confirmation cohorts.
research_chain.reviewed_decision: Reject unchanged unconditional H72 as a qualified 10K policy. Select LW-H2 as the explanation of this round and preregister LW-H3a as the next causal test.
research_chain.successor: Fresh 10K conditional activation experiment; do not advance unchanged H72 to 12K.

exploratory_stratification.interpretation: Three-handle rows gained approximately 7.6 and 8.1 percentage points in the two cohorts; lower-count rows were neutral or negative. This was not preregistered and is hypothesis-generating only.

successor_hypothesis.statement: At 10K, terminal handles improve quality within the token constraint only when the prefix yields the full three-handle receipt-bound evidence set; otherwise the policy should preserve the control terminal review.
successor_hypothesis.prediction: A fresh fixed-denominator conditional cohort gains at least 5 pp macro Span-F1, does not degrade secondary metrics or valid selections, and uses no more aggregate tokens than control.
successor_hypothesis.falsifier: A causally valid fresh 10K cohort with a preregistered three-handle activation predicate misses any semantic or aggregate-token gate.
guardrails: Trigger is computed only from prefix evidence before either branch response.
Inactive pairs receive no handle state and remain in the fixed denominator.
No identity exposed in Rounds 56-58 may be reused.
The subgroup evidence above cannot count as confirmation.

claim_ceiling: Unchanged H72 is not confirmed as a 10K default. LW-H3a is a preregistered successor hypothesis, not an established capability or product policy.
open_questions: Can a prefix-only three-handle trigger be implemented without changing inactive branch semantics?
Does the replicated handle-count split survive a fresh conditional cohort?
12K remains blocked until a 10K policy confirms.
